run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare branching of wiki files
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to copy each file with a version prefix via svn
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update links in branched wiki files using WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to rewrite cross-references
summarize_DropWikiSuffix: summarize the DropWikiSuffix function which removes the .wiki suffix from a filename
